query: How does the A1 operation registry dispatch operations?

recall_results.summary: A1 operation registry: the #[op] proc-macro in rein-macros expands OpsRuntime methods into inventory-registered entries dispatched by CLI, MCP, and REST adapters.
evidence_preview: OpsRuntime methods authored once via #[op] macro
inventory crate registers handlers at link time

recall_results.summary: AuthPolicy middleware was added in v0.21 A1 and registered through inventory; OpsErrorKind maps to HTTP status codes via the ReinError adapter.
Phase 3 of A1 deleted the old ops/registry.rs middleman; drift checks now compare source-scan against inventory::iter directly.
evidence_preview: single source of truth: the proc-macro

recall_results.summary: Single-seg path templates introduced in A1 enable GET /api/memories/{id} style routing through the inventory dispatch layer.
evidence_preview: REST inventory dispatch reuses CLI handlers

query: What does HDBSCAN clustering do for the adaptive engine?

recall_results.summary: HDBSCAN semantic clustering in rein extracts flat clusters from a stability-scored condensed tree; output feeds M2 alpha optimization, M3 decay, and A1 per-cluster dedup thresholds.
The HDBSCAN pipeline samples when n>3000 to bound clustering cost; the dendrogram is built from mutual reachability distances and reduced via EOMBST.
evidence_preview: samples when n>3000 to bound cost

recall_results.summary: Clusters from store/hdbscan.rs are consumed by store/adaptive.rs and ops/adaptive.rs to learn per-cluster fusion weights and survival curves.
